scheme_name: Term Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, Jains)
Income thresholds differ for rural (₹98,001–₹8,00,000) and urban (₹1,20,001–₹8,00,000) areas
Applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹30,00,000 at a concessional interest rate are provided to individuals from minority communities to enhance employability.
